label: rare: early copy-phase input of d/y/v/l (no coherent trigger)
explanation: Extremely sparse feature (about 0.001% of steps, ~93 of 1M sequences) with weak magnitude (max 0.20). About 75% of activation mass is in the copy phase, mostly at recall_idx 1-3 (fed-back copies of early original tokens), with in_tok enriched for d, y, v, l (first_tok y/d also enriched). The rest is at the final original-phase steps of long sequences (orig_idx 7-8, e.g. z, d, l just before <DEL>). Never fires at t<5 or on tokens a, b, c, e. The coarse predicate covers ~71% of activations but has precision ~0.0002 (it fires on ~200k steps for each one active). Adding output-token or prefix-set conditions did not raise precision meaningfully, so whatever triggers it is a specific combination of tokens that these variables do not pick out. Magnitude varies little (median 0.116), with no clear modulator.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: recall_idx=1 & in_tok=v (+3.09), prev_tok=g (+2.27), phase=2 & out_tok=r (+2.24), orig0=y (+1.92), phase=2 & out_tok=l (+1.91), phase=2 & in_tok=y (+1.85). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-2.29), next_out=- (-1.80), orig8=- (-1.10), to_go=3 (-0.66).
